verdict.rationale: Codegen's evidence shows a structured-plan behavior setting, per-capability permission toggles such as PR creation, and an API to resume paused runs. None of these is a documented setting that makes the agent auto-approve all its actions instead of confirming each one. These are adjacent controls, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to auto-approve all its actions instead of confirming each one
